A '''Ralltiiri glowmite''' was a type of creature. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Narsk Ka'hane]] considered them to be less suicidal than members of the death cult that served the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]].
